name: Narrated Live CAD Tutorials
highlights: Eight narrated live tutorials and 83 verified steps drive the real application with an animated cursor, synchronized captions and browser speech
Tutorial 1 prepares the full owner-approved Hino FM EURO5 with real AI auto-orient, local presentation coloring, AI classification, rename, BOM, design review and Chat actions
Tutorials 2 through 4 continue from that same prepared Hino; review evidence is shown progressively, cleaned from the viewport and retained in Review Memory and the generated report
Purpose-fit CAX-IF, Autodesk FDM, Zenodo CNC and NIST AP242 benchmarks operate revision, repair, print, machining, drawing, PMI and tolerance workflows
The running player provides step position, safe Previous and Next, 0.75x–2x synchronized pacing, natural-voice selection, pause, mute, stop and Escape
A persistent completion navigator provides Next, Replay, All tutorials and Close, with idempotent replay and save-before-replace protection
